verdict.rationale: Databricks offers a no-cost Free Edition workspace for experimenting, which replaced the retired Community Edition, plus a free trial. Databricks Connect and local dbt Core let engineers write and debug transformations from a local IDE, but the code still executes on Databricks compute rather than a local engine. Missing for 10: a documented local engine or emulator for offline development, evidence that Free Edition works as a dev sandbox mirroring production pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of loop speed.
